legal_units.title: Presumption as to culpable mental state.
legal_units.text: In any prosecution for any offence under this Act, which requires a culpable mental state on the part of the accused, the court shall presume the existence of such mental state but it shall be a defence for the accused to prove the fact that he had no such mental state with respect to the Act charged as an offence in that prosecution.

legal_units.title: Presumption as to culpable mental state.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this section, the expression "culpable mental state" includes intention, motive or knowledge of a fact or belief in, or reason to believe, a fact.

legal_units.title: Presumption as to culpable mental state.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this section, a fact is said to be proved only when the court believes it to exist beyond reasonable doubt and not merely when its existence is established by a preponderance of probability.
